label: masters
notes: Nine wagons, forty-one head, eleven hands, and a Bell Harrow debt that has outlived two partners: one bad crossing from foreclosure, and everyone on the plain knows it. The name is on the tally-stick and the tile and nowhere else. Her firm has no slack in it, which is why 'do the right thing' and 'lose the outfit' are the same sentence for her from chapter 3 onward.
